engineering_continuity.scope: Same pipeline source, policies, protocol, candidate addendum and component recipes are required before target reconstruction. Learned bytes may differ across platforms; pointwise original-target continuity and exact identity/count/scoring invariants are always required afterward. Same-local fitted models require strict losses; portable fitted variants must independently pass all unchanged engineering gates while exposing strict-loss deltas/failures. This is consumed-label regression evidence, never a new audit.

reproduced_engineering.scope: Strict loss reproduction checks primary, cohort and history-slice errors and bootstrap summaries at declared precision. Business IDs, original future-target hashes, slice identities, counts, scoring invariants and acceptance remain exact; actual shares allow only summation roundoff. Strict loss failure remains recorded even if a different-fitted same-recipe portable build independently qualifies under the unchanged engineering gates. V5 labels are consumed.

engineering_regression_qualification.scope: Same-local-fitted reruns must reproduce losses strictly. A differing-fitted portable build with exact source, policy, documents and recipes must independently pass every unchanged gate against pointwise-verified original stored targets, plus exact identities/counts/scoring invariants. Its actual losses and strict reproduction failures remain visible; it is neither a byte-identical predictor nor a new independent audit.

truth_scope: Every business, expense and future net-flow target in this report is synthetic. More real-trained forecast usage does not make expenses, capacity scores or repayment outcomes real-labeled. This is an engineering regression guard, not evidence of bank performance.
audit_lineage: Fourth exploratory sequential cycle: v2 rejected the 60%/25% policy because mean real weight 0.4969444444444444 missed the unchanged 0.50 gate; v3 and v4 both failed the unchanged 15% cohort-regression gate despite other aggregate/weight checks passing. Preserve all three outcomes as engineering-audit-v2-rejected.json/.md, engineering-audit-v3-rejected.json/.md and engineering-audit-v4-rejected.json/.md. History-only net reliability routers were explored exclusively on original training/development cases using already-observed historical 12-month target windows and finite margins 0/5/10/15; they were not selected for serving. The existing median_share12 observed-cost projection and guard65/25/25 policy are selected from the original finite grid with a tighter 10% development cohort buffer and accurately summed 55% development mean-share cushion. The independent audit remains 15% and mean50; reserved target labels supply no corrective coefficients. Real fitting recipe/candidate, generator, synthetic comparator recipe and audit thresholds remain frozen during policy reselection; portable fitted-byte differences are disclosed. V5 positions 4,000,000–4,000,899 were reserved before their target construction. Multiple failure-driven revisions make the development path exploratory; a later pass is not guaranteed superiority or an unconditional single-shot confidence claim.
presentation_only_clarification: Presentation-only clarification after measurement: frozen recipes are distinguished from portable fitted-byte differences. Numeric results, measured timestamp and recorded evaluator SHA256 still identify the original measurement; no fitting or scoring was rerun.
